title: The strong Choquet characterization of Polish spaces
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: For every second-countable metrizable topological space, the second player has a winning full-history strong Choquet strategy if and only if the topology admits a complete metric, equivalently if and only if the space is Polish. Moves include a marked point which every response must retain. The difficult converse constructs a coherent countable response tree, proves the embedded image is Gδ, and transfers complete metrizability from the metric completion.
